content: Yesu Ɩwɩtsɛ́ɛ
Nkensíé ɔma a, Yesu lɛ́kpa Petro mʋa Yakobo pʋ́ mʋ pio Yohane, bɔdʋ yɔ́ ɩbʋ kʋsʋ.
Amʋ́ ansɩ́tɔ́ ɩnʋ á, Yesu ɩwɩ lɛtsɛ. Mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́ lɔ́wankɩ́ fɛ́ owí, mʋ atadɩɛ ɛ́ lɛdamlí fútútúútú.
Ɩnʋnʋ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ abasá ámʋ bowun ánɩ́ Mose mʋa Elia bɛlɛ ɩwɩ ɔwan, amʋ́a Yesu bʋdɛtɔɩ́.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Petro lɛ́bláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, ɩbʋ alɛ́á abétsiá nfɩ. Nɩ́ fótsulá á, ha ada abú asa. Fʋ́ klɛ́ kʋlɛ, Mose klɛ́ kʋlɛ, Elia ɛ́ klɛ́ kʋlɛ.”
Brɛ́á ɔdɛ asʋ́n ánfɩ blɩ́ á, agyinde wánkɩ́hɛ́ kʋ lobobun amʋ́sʋ́. Ɩnʋ ɔmɛ kʋ lɛdalɩ tsu agyinde ámʋtɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔ́nɩ gyí mɩ́ Bí ɔdwɛpʋ́á olegyi mɩ ansɩ́ nɩ́. Mlɩnu mʋ ɔmɛ.”
Ifú lɛhɩɛ kɩ́tá amʋ́ brɛ́á bonu asʋ́n ánfɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔwa ɔsa mlí bun ɔsʋlʋ́tɔ.
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́ba bɔpʋ ɩbɩ dada amʋ́, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩkʋsʋ, mlɩmánya ifú.”
Ɩnʋ bɔwa ansɩ́ kɩ a, bʋmɛtrá wun ɔhaa dʋn Yesu nkʋlɛ.
Brɛ́á bʋdɛ ɩbʋ ámʋ kplɩ́ á, Yesu lɛ́da amʋ́ ɔlá ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋmábláa ɔhaa tɔ́á bayówun, yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá Bulu ɔbɔ́kʋsʋ́a Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ámʋ tsú afúlitɔ.
Mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ amʋ bɛɛ, ilehián ánɩ́ Elia obéyinkí bá asa Kristo amʋ ɔbɛ́ba?”
Ɔlɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ igyi. Elia obégyankpá bá bɛla tógyítɔ́ yáɩ́ wankláán.
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, Elia layínkí bá dodoodo, támɛ ɔhaa mɛ́bɩ mʋ. Bɔwa mʋ amʋmʋyɔ. Alɩ kɛ́n mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɛ́ nówun ɩwɩɔsɩn amʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ nɩ́.”
Ɩnʋ á, ɩlɔwankɩ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ánɩ́ Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane ɩwɩ asʋ́n ɔdɛblɩ́.
Ɩlɔ Dɩ́dahɛ Ɔlɔpʋ́ Tsa
Brɛ́á beyinkí kplɩ́ bowie ɔdɔm amʋ wá á, oyin ɔkʋ lɛ́ba bɛda akpawunu Yesu ayabitɔ, bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Mɩ́ Wíé, wun mɩ́ bí ánfɩ nwɛ, tsúfɛ́ ɩlɔ dɩ́dahɛ dɛ mʋ háan. Otetsíá dɩda wíé ntsu mʋ́a ogyátɔ́.
Nɔpʋ mʋ ba fʋ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ, támɛ bʋmɛtalɩ́ tsá mʋ ɩlɔ.”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ndɛmba-abíá mlɩmá hógyi, mlɩ tsiátɔ́ ma alɛ. Alɩ́ nétsiá mlɩ wá yɔ́ ekekegyíɛkɛ nɩ́? Nnyá klʋn ha mlɩ yɔ́fʋn ɔmɛnkɛ? Mlɩkpa kebi ámʋ ba mɩ!”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɔkplʋ́n gya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ. Ɩlɛdalɩ kebi ámʋtɔ, ɩwɩ lɔ́wa mʋ ɔnlɩn.
Mʋ́ ɔma a, akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu ɩtsɛ́tɔ́ bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ anɩ mʋ́ anɩmɛ́talɩ́ gya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ amʋ dálɩ kebi ámʋtɔ?”

Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩ hógyi mɔtsɔ́ kʋ́ráá. Mbláa mlɩ ɔnɔkwalɩ. Nɩ́ mlɩ hógyi lomoní fɛ́ takyí-akpin ibí á, tɛkɩ mlɛ́talɩ́ bláa ɩbʋ ánfɩ mlɩaa ipúli. Lɛ́lɛ́ ibópulí, tɔtɔɔtɔ mɔ́ɔdʋn mlɩ bwɛ.”
Yesu Lowu Ɩwɩ Asʋ́n Blɩ́ Otse Nyɔɔsɩ

Brɛ́á akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛba befia Galilea ɔmátɔ́ á, Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bɛ́lɛ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ há adʋ́n bɔ́mɔ mɩ́, támɛ Bulu ɔbɔ́kʋsʋ́a mɩ ɛkɛ sáásɩ́.” Asʋ́n ánfɩ lɛhɩɛ han akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ.
Bulu Ɔtswɛ́kpa Ofí Ɩkɔka
Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bɛba Kapernaum wúlutɔ. Ɩnʋ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa ofíkɔ ahɔ́pʋ akʋ bɛba bɛfɩtɛ́ Petro bɛɛ, “Fʋ́ wíe tɛká Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa ofí ɩkɔ?”

Petro lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔtɛká.” Brɛ́á Petro lɔ́yɔ wóyítɔ́ a, Yesu légyankpá fɩ́tɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Simon, nkálɩ gyí fʋ́ agywɩɩn? Amɛndɩ tɛ́ká dútɛ mʋ́a lampóo há awíe? Afɔɔ́ ntɛ́ɛ wúlu awíe?”
Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Afɔɔ́ tɛká.” Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Yɛ́ɛ mʋ́mʋ́ wúlu awíe bagyi ɩwɩ nɩ́?

Támɛ mmedéklé mbɛ́ɛ, abɔ́kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ amʋ́sʋ́ sʋ á, tsu ɔdadʋwa afʋyɔ ɔpʋ ɔnɔ́ yɔtswɩ. Kɩ klɛmɛtɩ́ gyankpapʋ ánɩ́ fɛ́lɛ ɔnɔ́tɔ́. Fénya kɔ́ba ánɩ́ ɩbɔ́fʋn anɩ abanyɔ́ ofíkɔ ámʋ ka. Lɛ mʋ́, afʋyɛka ha amʋ́.”

footnotes.text: -21 Mʋ́tɔ́ yée 21 bʋ nwʋlʋ́ dada amʋ akʋtɔ: Támɛ ɩ́nɩ odu mʋ́ á, nkɛ́tɩ mpáɩ mʋ́a ɔnɔ́klɩ́ pɛ́ mlɛ́talɩ́ pʋ́gya mʋ́.
